text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3cfe245ae5f381d1844ad1cf7e4c3053 as of 2026-09-02T08:33:44.360Z: {"title":"Bruce McGuigan · Mayor · chal"} **Filled card. Not published.** Bruce McGuigan · Mayor · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site (principles + ten priority areas) and 20 Aug 2026 CHEK launch coverage. No VoteMate profile, no questionnaire, no costed platform, no 2022–26 City term. Challenger: 2026 plan taken at face value, no record haircut. 2018 questionnaire and 2018 X bio are not 2026 sources. ## Card
Field Value
Name Bruce McGuigan
Office Mayor
Kind chal (no 2022–26 City term — 2026 plan taken at face value, no record haircut)
Platform URL (2026) [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/)
Platform lastmod not published on the site (Netlify; sitemap lastmod 2026-01-01 is a Hugo template placeholder, not a real edit date)
Retrieved 2026-09-02
Scored answers (measures with an answer) **13 / 55**
Record lines 📋 (shown, not scored) 0 (no City office held 2022–26)
Letter (only at 5 scored answers: B+, B, C, D, or —) **—** · awaiting Joa's click. Internal proposal at the bottom of this page.
Checked by · date Verifier · 2026-09-02
### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **—** No residential rate, cap, formula or glide path. Value-for-money and "public purse" language is scored on rows 41–42, not as a tax rule. CHEK's recap of a 2018 X bio is not a 2026 rate position. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Downtown order M26 / M27 **said** "I support appropriate policing and enforcement alongside prevention, better public-space design, late-night safety, civilian and health responses where appropriate, and serious action on homelessness, mental illness and addiction." No Public Order Team and no bylaw-hours position. The sentence is scored once, on row 7 (M26b). [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Housing M6 **said** "That means market and non-market housing, non-profit housing, supportive and complex-care housing, family-sized rentals, affordable paths to ownership and protection of existing lower-cost rental homes." Types named; no unit target, no composition share, no tenure percentage. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **—** Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number are not mentioned. — —
Written program — **yes** An authorized campaign site with three guiding principles, ten priority areas, a biography, volunteer/pledge forms and a financial-agent authorization. Written and current. No numerical targets, costs, implementation dates or measure-by-measure delivery plan. /posts/hello-world/ and /pages/about/ are still template stubs. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Weak 0.5** "That means market and non-market housing, non-profit housing, supportive and complex-care housing, family-sized rentals, affordable paths to ownership and protection of existing lower-cost rental homes." · Agrees with a mixed composition as a goal. No unit target, no 3-bedroom share, no below-market share, no tenure percentage, no zoning or approval instrument. Context, not scored separately: "Victoria needs much more housing, but the goal cannot simply be more units." The demolition sentence is scored once, on row 21. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops **Weak 0.5** "Public land should create lasting public value, and new development should consider affordability and displacement alongside supply." · Agrees with the public-land-value goal M6b is built on. No City land bank, no acquisition fund, no co-op financing. Community-wealth "co-operatives" are economic actors, not housing co-ops, and are not scored here. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position, no published standard, nothing on AI pre-screening. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs do not appear. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No unified command, co-location or downtown operations desk. The policing-and-civilian sentence is scored once, on row 7. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response **Close 2.0** "I support appropriate policing and enforcement alongside prevention, better public-space design, late-night safety, civilian and health responses where appropriate, and serious action on homelessness, mental illness and addiction." · Commits to civilian and health responses as part of the safety mix. Comparable to M26b (civilian crisis response so the wrong responder stops absorbing officer time), not the same: no CRCL, IMCRT or VCOT named, no dispatch criteria, no funding figure. One sentence, one measure: homelessness in this list is not a second mark. Context: "Homelessness is not synonymous with crime, and public safety policy should focus on harmful behaviour rather than someone’s housing status or background." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — "no one left living on our streets" is the homelessness-end goal, scored on row 23, not a daytime-sheltering bylaw. Face-test: that sentence cannot be defended as a bylaw position. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — Harm reduction is named inside the homelessness housing list on row 23. No child-focused buffer, no bylaw/DPOT, no VicPD/CDSA position. Mention of harm reduction is a dash. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — "Compassion does not require accepting violence, harassment, predatory behaviour or serious public disorder" is a conduct principle, not an encampment protocol, a named-space reclaim, or night lighting. Adjacency is not a source. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — No residential rate, cap, formula, year-path or override. "tax dollar" as a public trust is scored on row 41. Naming taxes without a rate goal is a Mention, so a dash. 2018 X "hard-knocks fiscal management" is not a 2026 sentence. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no supermajority override. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — "A Mayor has to be willing to challenge provincial and federal governments when necessary, while working constructively with them to get more housing built" is senior-government advocacy on housing, used as context on row 23. It is not a downloading ledger, a refusal threshold, or a published transfer table. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — CRD is named for housing cooperation, not for regional cost disclosure or the filtration plant. Mention of the CRD, so a dash. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Close 2.0** "City Hall should be at the centre of a proud, ongoing Buy Local campaign that encourages residents, businesses and public institutions to support our local economy." · Commits to a named local-economy campaign. Comparable to M71's downtown/business instrument set, not the same: no vacancy target, no Strategic Economic Plan, no "one mandate not a new office." Context, same block, not scored separately: "Victoria should be one of the best small cities in the world to start a business," and City Hall as a stronger partner on transportation, clean and safe streets, employee housing and infrastructure. Local-procurement wording in the same block is the same claim and is not scored again on row 47. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour, no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. The congestion-tax sentence is scored on row 27. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — Territorial acknowledgement plus "Indigenous communities" and "Indigenous businesses" on engagement and wealth lists. No standing government-to-government table, no procurement target, no place-name programme, no cultural-protocol package, no urban Indigenous liaison. Acknowledgement without those instruments is a dash. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "City hall cannot continue to approve the demolition of rental housing for the construction of condos that are unaffordable for citizens." · Commits to stopping rental-to-unaffordable-condo demolition, which is a comparable tenant-protection / demoviction instrument. Not the same as a demoviction bylaw, STR licensing, or an indoor-heat standard. Protection of lower-cost rentals inside the M6 composition sentence is not scored again. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — Housing allocation and waitlists do not appear. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput **Close 2.0** "My approach is to build the working system needed to change that: clear responsibility, coordinated action with provincial and regional partners, measurable results, and tracking whether improvements actually last." · Commits to a coordinated homelessness-delivery system. Comparable to M11's Housing First + STEP operating system, not the same: Housing First and STEP are not named, no 50% unsheltered target, no quarterly count. Context, same section, not scored separately: "homelessness should be rare, brief and non-recurring, with no one left living on our streets"; "working together around individual transitions into permanent housing"; supportive and complex-care housing with treatment and recovery; "no discharge into homelessness from hospitals, corrections, detox, treatment or other public systems"; and challenging other governments when necessary to get housing built. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — "from students to retiring long term locals" raises age groups with no childcare-space, family-doctor or 18–25 instrument. Mentions, so a dash. Family-sized rentals sit inside the sentence already scored on row 1. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — "clean and safe streets" appears in a business-partner list, used as context on row 18. Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear. A list item is a Mention, so a dash. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Partial 1.0** "We also need to start eliminating the hidden congestion tax paid by businesses, governments and individuals when people and goods sit unnecessarily in traffic." · Commits to cutting congestion as a municipal cost. No adaptive-signal programme, no Vision Zero audit, no named corridor, no calming design. Context, same block, not scored separately: better transit and transportation planning to move more people while freeing road space for businesses, emergency services and people who need to drive. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — "Better transit and transportation planning" sits in the same climate/mobility block as the sentence scored on row 27. One sentence, one measure. No sidewalk-gap standard, no City-controlled transit-lever list. Transit service itself is not a City decision (M23b). — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — "accessibility advocates" appears on an engagement list. No accessibility audit, no public-washroom standard. Mention, so a dash. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "good infrastructure" is a list item on row 18's partner sentence. No maintenance backlog, pothole standard or sequencing rule. Mention, so a dash. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Businesses "carrying costs that shouldn’t be theirs alone" is about congestion and cleanliness, not spreading private-security costs. Adjacency is not a source. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — The civilian-and-health sentence is scored on row 7. Community paramedicine is not named separately. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) — "appropriate policing and enforcement" is inside the sentence scored on row 7. No VicPD funding formula, no Esquimalt, no convene-and-publish regional review. Not Opposed: he supports policing alongside civilian response, and that is not a defund. — —
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. "late-night safety" is inside the sentence scored on row 7. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — No safety dashboard, no crime-reduction number. City-wide measurement is scored on row 42, not as a public-safety KPI. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage standards, street furniture and cultural venues do not appear. The arts live/work sentence is scored on row 39. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — Pedestrianisation and a signature-project shortlist do not appear. Congestion relief is scored on row 27, not as pedestrianisation. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Heritage incentives, ornamental lighting and parks programmes do not appear. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor **Weak 0.5** "Victoria should be a place where artists, musicians, performers, writers, designers and cultural organizations can live, work and create." · Agrees with an arts-ecosystem goal. No funding floor, no dollar, no sport. 2018 ProArt answers are not a 2026 source. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — "I am proudly pro-union and support living wages, secure employment, apprenticeships and strong public services." · Explicitly pro-union. That does not establish a position on managed competition of City services. Face-test: pro-union is not Opposed here. Dash, not −1.0. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Weak 0.5** "Treat every tax dollar, public asset and major project as a public trust: know what it costs, what it is supposed to achieve and whether people received value for their money." · Agrees with the value-for-money test M65 exists to serve. No zero-based cycle, no grant threshold, no three-part test, no savings number. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard **Partial 1.0** "Set clear goals, assign responsibility, measure results, finish what works and fix what doesn’t." · Commits to a goals-responsibility-results operating method. No dashboard, no KPI set, no quarterly cadence. Context, not scored separately: "City Hall should know whether an initiative actually solved the problem or merely moved it somewhere else," and major-decision public accounting (what was spent, why, who benefited, what the public received, where revenue was forgone). [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — The public-land sentence is scored on row 2. City operational holdings are not addressed. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — "Let’s try to make every dollar we spend on the things that we need sustain our neighbours and community" is the same local-spend claim as the Buy Local sentence scored on row 18. One sentence, one measure. No local-tech, open data, Wi-Fi or EV charging. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic **Partial+ 1.5** "Victoria needs practical action on building efficiency, extreme heat and wildfire smoke, resilient public facilities, water management, local food security, public transit and active transportation." · Agrees with operational climate action and names comparable instruments (building efficiency, heat/smoke, resilient facilities). Not the same as M58's 50%/2030 set, district energy, or a seismic programme. Transit and active transportation in this sentence are not given a second mark on row 27 or 49. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness — No 5,000-tree target, no canopy, no ecosystems programme, no emergency-preparedness position. Mode share sits inside sentences already scored on rows 27 and 48. — —
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule **Partial 1.0** "Engagement should happen early enough for people to genuinely influence decisions, not after the important choices have already been made." · Commits to consultation before commitment, with no 25-million referendum threshold, no 5-step sequence and no material-change rule. [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02 \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule **Partial 1.0** "Engagement should happen early enough for people to genuinely influence decisions, not after the important choices have already been made." · Commits to consultation-before-commitment, which is M78 step 1. No 5-step sequence, no \$25M threshold, no material-change rule. Context: "There should be no surprises from City Hall." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response **Close 2.0** "Good decisions start by listening to residents, frontline workers, businesses, community organizations and people with direct experience, then showing how what we heard affected the decision." · Commits to a published account of how input changed the decision, which is comparable to M79b's 60-day consultation-response standard. Not the same office (no Integrity Commissioner, no MNP tracker, no 60-day clock). Context, not scored separately: "Residents should know what is actually open for decision, see a fair account of what was heard, and understand how their input affected the result." [https://bruceformayor.ca/](https://bruceformayor.ca/) lastmod n/p, retrieved 2026-09-02
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration — "understandable budgets, transparent contracts and spending" is transparency tone inside a kitchen-sink Citizens-First sentence. No lobbyist registry, no FOI-fee position, no remuneration rule. Mention, so a dash. — —
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans — "neighbourhoods" appears on an engagement list. No grant line, no language-access standard, no Local Area Plan programme. Mention, so a dash. — —
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — "more opportunities for residents to participate between elections" raises between-elections participation with no survey, advance-vote or ballot-access instrument. Mention, so a dash. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear on the 2026 site. The 2018 Times Colonist line "Victoria must amalgamate itself first" is not a 2026 source and is not imported. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [bruceformayor.ca home / platform](https://bruceformayor.ca/) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [posts index](https://bruceformayor.ca/posts/) · [hello-world stub](https://bruceformayor.ca/posts/hello-world/) · [about stub](https://bruceformayor.ca/pages/about/) · [CHEK launch, 20 Aug 2026](https://cheknews.ca/victoria-mayoral-race-takes-shape-as-challengers-enter-with-less-than-two-months-to-go-1343203/) · [ACTW live profile](https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/mcguigan) (verified 1 Sep 2026; re-checked 2 Sep 2026) · VoteMate Victoria mayor list (riding 804, retrieved 2026-09-02) — McGuigan not listed; Alto only. - **Not a source, applied:** sociology professorship, Family Services ED, Social Innovation Centre, VIRCS acting ED, LinkedIn career dates (professional background); 2018 Times Colonist questionnaire (amalgamation, regional transit, trickle-down housing, "we can’t solve it alone," municipal taxpayers cannot fund senior-government failures); 2018 ProArt survey; 2018 X bio quoted by CHEK; 2018 fourth-place result. Challenger rule: 2026 plan at face value. No slate *we* exists to mis-attribute. - **Searched and not found:** VoteMate candidate profile; any 2026 questionnaire; dated news posts on the campaign site; accessible 2026 YouTube titles/dates (channel indexed on the ACTW profile; content not scored); current X/Facebook/Instagram 2026 posting record. Absence is absence, not a fail. Social accounts were not touched. - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Thirteen sentences carry the thirteen scored cells: (1) housing-type list → row 1. (2) public land lasting value → row 2. (3) civilian and health responses → row 7. (4) Buy Local campaign → row 18. (5) stop approving rental demolition for unaffordable condos → row 21. (6) build the working system / measurable results on homelessness → row 23. (7) hidden congestion tax → row 27. (8) artists live, work and create → row 39. (9) tax dollar as public trust / value for money → row 41. (10) set goals, assign responsibility, measure results → row 42. (11) practical climate action on building efficiency, heat, smoke, resilient facilities → row 48. (12) engagement early enough to influence decisions → row 50. (13) showing how what we heard affected the decision → row 51. - **Contested allocations.** Row 7 Close 2.0 for unnamed "civilian and health responses where appropriate" is the easiest mark to argue down to Partial+ 1.5 (Agrees + comparable, no named team). Row 18 Close 2.0 for Buy Local is the easiest to argue down to Partial 1.0 (named campaign is not vacancy / SEP / one-mandate). Row 1 Weak 0.5 for a type-list without shares could be dashed as a Mention; kept because he names composition as a goal. Row 51 Close 2.0 matches the consultation-response half of M79/M79b, not the Integrity Commissioner half. Row 23 uses the working-system sentence rather than the functional-zero slogan so Q1 is Commits; the slogan is context. - **Not Opposed, recorded so it cannot be re-litigated as a fail.** Pro-union ≠ opposition to M15. Supporting "appropriate policing" ≠ a VicPD-funding position and ≠ a defund. Territorial acknowledgement ≠ M1–M5. 2018 amalgamation ≠ a 2026 M81 answer. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none. No City office held 2022–26. No 📋 Record lines. No incumbent haircut. - **Never-list:** no Lisnard / Estrosi / Knafo / Musk / Brivael / Poilievre language used as a source or analogy. M39 and M9c not scored. No M83 cell. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** row 13 (is there a residential-rate cap?) · row 7 (which civilian team, and who dispatches?) · row 23 (Housing First / STEP / a count?) · row 1 (any unit or share number?) · row 20 (anything beyond acknowledgement?). - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, and immediately if a VoteMate profile, questionnaire or costed platform appears. Re-check YouTube once titles and dates are readable. - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: C** · n = 13 · mean 1.27 Sum of scored marks: 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.0 + 1.5 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5 + 0.5 = **16.5** across **13** scored cells. Mean **1.269**, band **C** (1.25–1.49). C is already one of the five live letters, so no mapping is needed. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. The live letter waits for Joa's click and compute must not overwrite it. Alignment compute APPLIED for McGuigan stays **—** unless Joa clicks. **What the proposal is measuring.** Not hostility to the Program — there is no Opposed cell — but distance from its instruments. Five Closes (civilian response, Buy Local, demoviction stop, homelessness operating system, consultation-response) sit on comparable rather than same instruments. Four Weaks are goals without instruments. Forty-two cells are dashes because he has not spoken to them, not because he failed them. **Fragility.** Drop row 7 and row 18 from Close to Partial+ / Partial and the mean is 1.15 (C− → C). Dash the two housing Weaks and the mean is 1.41, still C. The letter is C because the Closes are comparable-not-same and the rest is Partial/Weak, not because the platform is empty.
